facts.where: section IV-A (setup), LLMs
facts.quote: We use three open-weight LLMs: Muse-Glimmer-30B [ 29 ] , Qwen3.8-27B [ 30 ] and GLM-5.3-Flash [ 18 ] , a larger mixture-of-experts model.

facts.where: section IV-A (setup)
facts.quote: On GLM-5.3-Flash, the agentic detectors use the FP8 version of the LLM and Reva an exact BF16 conversion, which leaves its cross-validation accuracy unchanged (66.2% vs. 65.9%).
facts.note: FLAG quantized: the agentic detectors (VulTriage, VulAgent) run the FP8 version; Reva runs an exact BF16 conversion
